question: Should each accepted proposal create its own Git commit, or should Archivist batch accepted proposals into review-session commits?
recommended_answer: One accepted model proposal or approved manual-draft batch should create one Git commit by default.
answer: One accepted model proposal or approved manual-draft batch should create one Git commit by default.
rationale: Policy content benefits from granular history and rollback investigation. Batching can be added later if review sessions become noisy.
